walkthroughs.body_html:
This topic is part of the Cambridge IGCSE GCSE English Language specification.

Component 4: Speaking and Listening appears in the assessment, so it's worth knowing well.

You'll meet Component 4: Speaking and Listening in exam questions and need to apply your knowledge.

The Cambridge IGCSE board expects you to understand both the concepts and how to use them.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Component 4: Speaking and Listening.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.
